title: A Weekend Email
text:
Hi Ana! How are you? I am writing to tell you about my weekend. On Saturday, I went to the park with my dog. The weather was sunny and warm.

On Sunday, I cooked dinner for my family. We ate pasta and salad. Please write back soon! Love, Maria.

questions.text: Where did Maria go on Saturday?
What did Maria's family eat on Sunday?
How does Maria probably feel about her weekend?
Why does Maria write 'Please write back soon'?
options: She wants to cancel a visit
She is moving to another city

vocabulary.definition: Saturday and Sunday, the days at the end of the week
with a lot of sunshine and no clouds
the main meal of the day, usually eaten in the evening
an animal that people often keep as a pet

paragraph_translations: ¡Hola Ana! ¿Cómo estás? Te escribo para contarte sobre mi fin de semana. El sábado fui al parque con mi perro. El clima estaba soleado y cálido.
El domingo cociné la cena para mi familia. Comimos pasta y ensalada. ¡Por favor, escríbeme pronto! Un abrazo, Maria.
